newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major to open constitution debate Thursday.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major to open constitution debate Thursday.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major is to open a parliamentary debate on the constitution on Thursday next week, a senior government official said.

The official said Major had decided to make the opening speech in the debate because "clearly the constitution is very much a matter for the prime minister. It does relate to the whole United Kingdom."

Major has criticised opposition Labour plans for devolution, which involve elected assemblies for Scotland and Wales, saying they would lead to the break up of the United Kingdom. -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-7768
